context: Daichi and Ren mark one year of watching games together.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: レン、もう、一年、試合、見てきた。
lines.en: Ren, I've watched a whole year of games with you now.
lines.style: Warm Kansai lilt on the opening. Bright and generous—remembering the stretch of time with genuine pleasure. The regional swing audible throughout. Soft, real warmth threading naturally through the delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、楽しい、時間、ばかり。
lines.en: Yeah—it's been nothing but good times.
lines.style: Quiet affirming nod in the voice. Soft, sincere warmth. Gentle pace. The gratitude is genuine but understated, not performed. Real warmth threading through without effort.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 応援、一緒に、する、いいやん。
lines.en: It's nice cheering together like this.
lines.style: Kansai warmth on the opening. Bright conviction without pushing. The regional swing audible. Generous and sincere—celebrating the friendship as much as the games. Soft real warmth throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Let's keep doing our best from here on.
lines.style: Commitment in the tone without strain. Soft and sincere. The gentle warmth of someone making a quiet promise. Real warmth threading through. Slight resolve on 頑張ろう without heaviness.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: I'm definitely going to the next game.
lines.style: Kansai bright closing conviction. The regional swing audible. Warm and resolute—no hesitation. Real affection underneath the certainty. Soft warmth threading through to the end.
